description_en: Retrieves the OSS reference repositories that can be added to the current instance
description_zh: 获取当前实例可添加的OSS引用仓库
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch list-alternative-snapshot-repos --instance-id es-cn-0pp1jxvcl000z0000 --already-set-items true --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAlternativeSnapshotRepos

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the OSS reference repositories that have already been added. Valid values:

- true: Returns the already added repositories.
- false: Does not return the already added repositories.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回已添加的OSS引用仓库。true为默认值，表示返回；false表示不返回
parameters.name: already_set_items
